authorization: User 'faz isso' authorizes closing funding-carry economics and deciding whether research is worthwhile. This updates the previous self-imposed stop on a public economic screen; G1 for deployment remains failed. No live execution, family reopening or data-collection change.
venue_reference: Binance USD-M USDT perpetual plus spot; public availability does not establish operator eligibility
benchmark_reference: Previous sourced candidate: effective Selic 13.90%, IR17.5%, B3 custody0.2% with R$10000 exemption; actual operator eligibility unknown
primary_statistic: Signed sum of historical settlement rates, simple annualization for 30/90d, and observed 365d normalized-notional funding. Never advertised APY or forecast.
secondary_accounting: If mark prices and historical spot prices cover the fixed window, compute funding for fixed hedge quantity, endpoint basis change, and cash margin stress; no invented fills or liquidations.
data_checks: all two symbols and three horizons reported
decision_rule: If even zero-cost normalized funding in the primary window at N=C fails the conditional BRL benchmark with FX unchanged, do not deepen this passive carry structure at this capital. Short-window outliers do not override the primary screen. Missing coverage gives INCONCLUSIVE_DATA_FIDELITY. No CONFIRMED_NO_EDGE claim for the whole class.
maximum_search: Two predefined assets, one venue, three fixed descriptive windows, no timing/threshold optimization, no candidate expansion after results.

economic_thesis.money: Funding received by the perpetual short while spot hedges cryptocurrency direction, plus endpoint basis P&L.
economic_thesis.payer: Perpetual long holders when funding is positive; the short pays when funding is negative.
economic_thesis.why_exists: Demand for leveraged long exposure and constraints on financing/custody/capital.
economic_thesis.persistence: Conditional on leverage demand and intermediation constraints; not guaranteed.
economic_thesis.competition: Professional carry desks compete; no measured execution or funding advantage for this stack.
economic_thesis.constrained_participant: Directional traders seeking leverage rather than spot ownership.
economic_thesis.capacity: Collateral, margin liquidity, counterparty concentration and book liquidity; unmeasured at scale.
economic_thesis.kills_edge: Funding compression/reversal, basis unwind, liquidation, costs, FX and opportunity cost.
economic_thesis.latency: Funding receipts are low frequency; hedge entry/unwind and liquidation risk still require timely execution.
economic_thesis.cheapest_falsification: Compare fixed-window historical receipts under zero-cost favorable conditions with the same-currency benchmark before funding execution infrastructure.
